tally.settings.title: Tally
tally.option.hudMode.tooltip: Auto shows the HUD only while you glide.
tally.option.cameraBank.tooltip: How far the view rolls into a turn, so the horizon tilts like in a real aircraft. 0% keeps the view level; the horizon line then only moves up and down.
tally.option.hudShadow.tooltip: A thin shadow under every line and number, so the HUD stays readable against snow and bright sky.
tally.option.flightPathMarker.tooltip: The small winged circle that shows where you are actually going, as opposed to where the nose points.
tally.option.radarRange.tooltip: The radar can only see players the server tells your game about, which on most servers is 100 to 130 blocks no matter how high this is set.
tally.option.radarCone.tooltip: How far off the nose the radar looks, to each side.
tally.option.targets.tooltip: What the radar marks and can lock.
tally.option.leadProjectiles.tooltip: With a bow, crossbow or trident in hand, the aim point shows where the shot has to go, allowing for the target's movement, the arrow's drop and your own speed.
tally.option.voice.tooltip: Off: the spoken warnings are replaced by tones.
tally.option.warnTerrain.tooltip: "Terrain" and then "Pull up" when your flight path runs into something fast enough to hurt. A gentle landing or a dive into water stays silent.
tally.option.pullUpTime.tooltip: Seconds before impact at which "Pull up" starts. "Terrain" comes about twice as early.
tally.option.warnAltitude.tooltip: One "Altitude" call as you sink below the height set here.
tally.option.warnStall.tooltip: Sounds when you are gliding too slowly to stay up.
tally.option.warnElytra.tooltip: "Caution" with a minute of elytra left, "Warning" in the last 15 seconds.
tally.option.warnProximity.tooltip: A chirp when a player you can see comes within the radius below, from any direction.
tally.option.warnThreat.tooltip: A warble and SPIKE with a clock direction when another player keeps their crosshair on you.
tally.option.warnBingo.tooltip: "Bingo" when you are down to your last three firework rockets.
